DEBUG: Post-implementation bug sweep found 8 bugs, all fixed.

CRITICAL (silent data corruption):
1. superseded_by not set on project memories — updateMemory whitelist didn't include superseded_by/related_to. FIX: Added both fields to whitelist in store.ts updateMemory(). Also fixed engine.ts and manager.ts to pass superseded_by when superseding project memories.

2. Supersedes ID parsing — curator might output '[#abc123]' but code only stripped '#'. FIX: Changed to replace(/[\[\]#]/g, '').trim() to handle all variants.

3. Rule 3 linking (related_to) was a no-op for project memories — logged success but skipped the update. FIX: Now that updateMemory supports related_to, the branch actually calls store.updateMemory.

SHOULD FIX:
4. this._config.projectPath doesn't exist on EngineConfig type — crash on store fallback. FIX: Changed to join(process.cwd(), this._config.localFolder).

5. Cross-segment dedup headlines had no IDs — added type prefix '(technical) headline...' format. Correct behavior is skip-not-supersede for in-flight segments.

6. Ingest race condition — re-queried recent memories instead of collecting IDs from storeMemory return values. FIX: Collect into sessionMemoryIds[] from return values.

7. Stray console.log in store.ts getLatestSummary. FIX: Changed to logger.debug().

8. replace() → replaceAll() in temporal class validator — was only replacing first hyphen/space.

PREVENT: When adding new fields to StoredMemory, always add them to updateMemory() whitelist in store.ts.
